description: Independent dual-speed exploration: cruise 5 cells in short/mid low-information regions (5 by N), then switch to stride 1 near a predicted concave summit. On the first descent from a record anchor, backfill the entire skipped cell to recover narrow peaks. Failed sweeps resume cruising; at most two forward/two backward sweeps and 19 fine reads. Preserve raw winner, proven ledgers, N-dependent tail stopping, legacy refinement and parking.
